'''Procurement officer''' was a role within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were responsible for procuring material and supplies for the Alliance. A young procurement officer once paid a exorbitant amount for a [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|VR-10 ''Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines''-class spacetug]] that the seller, [[Yearo Seville]], claimed was from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] and had vital information in its memory.
